name: Omnimon Zwart
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Trash the top 3 cards of your deck. Then, you may play up to 2 play cost 8 or less black or purple Digimon cards from your trash without paying the costs.
[When Attacking] By returning 1 level 6 Digimon card in this Digimon's digivolution cards to the hand, delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with a play cost of 12 or less.
